test_extract_patches_2d: test extract_patches on 2D images with VALID and SAME padding modes against TensorFlow reference
test_extract_patches_0d: test extract_patches on 0D images where patching is a no-op and returns the original array
test_extract_patches_1d: test extract_patches on 1D images by comparing JAX output to TensorFlow with an extra singleton dimension
test_extract_patches_3d: test extract_patches on 3D volumetric images and reconstruct the original from non-overlapping patches
test_extract_patches_raises: test that extract_patches raises ValueError when sizes, strides, or rates have mismatched lengths
